explanation: The article "Scramble for Africa" (revision 1373841219) states: "The tensions between the imperial powers led to a succession of crises, which exploded in August 1914, when previous rivalries and alliances created a domino situation that drew the major European nations into World War I." The tensions are the scramble's own, in the scramble's own article. This is written as precondition-of, because the sentence makes the rivalry what the crises grew out of.
